title: Day 2/100 of Agentic Trading $10,000 on Robinhood
author: Newrateacc
selftext:
Portfolio: $10,764.24 (+195) across Robinhood, Coinbase, and Kalshi 

Day 2 went even. Not including after hours was down $18.34 (down 0.17%). Red day, as promised these get posted too. 26 agents live.

Biggest mover, down: AI Picks & Shovels, $1,027.62, down $22.92 (down 2.18%). This is its weekly reweight day. It sold AMD, ANET, and DELL, then bought more NVDA and opened a new SMCI position at $38.77. The loss is mark to market on the old holdings before the swap, not the trade itself.

Biggest mover, up: Crypto Trend Following, $59.31, up $4.07 (up 7.37%). Daily trend rotation across BTC, ETH, and SOL. It sold its SOL position at $112.60 and split the proceeds into BTC at $80,923 and ETH at $2,611.73 since both flipped back above their 30 day average.

Crypto Rotator, $258.04, up $12.11 (up 4.92%). The Critic, $57.93, up $2.06 (up 3.69%), trades Kalshi Rotten Tomatoes score markets. The Silicon Overdrive, $94.56, up $2.30 (up 2.49%), the 2x leveraged semiconductor sleeve.

FAANG+ Momentum, $2,424.80, up $2.28, basically flat. It rotated out of META and NVDA into AMZN and GOOGL on the daily momentum rerank.

High Profile Congress, $494.44, down $4.09 (down 0.82%). Sold FSLR and WDAY, bought IJR and OTIS off a fresh disclosure.

Pelosi Tracker, $517.09, down $4.52 (down 0.87%). Sold INTC, bought BE (Bloom Energy) on her latest disclosed buy.

Red & P 15, $99.69, roughly flat. This is the one that picks 15 S&P companies aligned with the American right by AI model each week. Today was its first real buy, it built the full 15 name basket: COP, CVX, EOG, LMT, MPC, NOC, NWSA, OXY, PM, PSX, RTX, SLB, TSCO, VLO, XOM.

Business As Usual, $2,536.86, down $6.98 (down 0.27%). No trade yesterday, it only moves on weather signal days and yesterday wasn't one.

Everything else was single digit dollar moves either way. Two days in, up $199 then down $18, net still green. This is exactly why day 1 or day 2 alone proves nothing, the point is posting all 100.

comments.author: MrKittyCatMeowFace03
comments.body:
Congress and Pelosi, have you tried checking day of entry and build a controller around it. To see where current price stand \[vs\] time of buy? Also would recommend running studies around ETF like SPY, see if your strategies beat avg. return. Unless your whole strategy is about the momentum finders.

Also how do you stop drawdowns?

replies.author: Newrateacc
replies.body:
That’s a good point, I think taking into account if a Pelosi or congress stock already went up since they bought could be a good sign that it’s already what they wanted. 

But yes def trying to compare these agents on Raijin vs SPY, some have been doing better so far

comments.author: VisibleBee
comments.body: The headline P&L is only one layer. I would preserve the exact information and tool responses available at each decision, then compare the agent with a rules-only baseline including fills, fees, turnover, abstentions, concentration, and drawdown. That makes the result reproducible instead of just a live scorecard.
